content.introduction: Bitcoin steadies near $78,000 as Binance withdrawals resume, according to Yahoo Finance. The crypto market saw Bitcoin and altcoins retreat as Binance experienced over $4.6 billion in withdrawals since restoring its service. Crypto firms have also written to US lawmakers to push for stablecoin regulation. Additionally, the SEC has proposed new regulations allowing crypto companies to raise up to $5 million for up to four years for a token after publishing a white paper.
